Final results are in the Project/Program Completion Reports | Nov 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/40075/40075-023-40075-033-40075-043-pcr-en.pdf
Grant 0434: 86% of contracts awarded and 86% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Loan 3121: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Progress Toward Outcome: Project Physically completed on 10 Dec 2017. Final bills are awaited to be submitted for the payment.
Some results are in the Environmental Impact Assessments | Mar 2016: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//40075-033-043-eia-01.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Nov 2013: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//40075-033-rp-04.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/40075/40075-033-smr-en_2.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 2 Civil works contracts have been mobilized for the construction of 39 km road in Mar 2015.
Project Physically completed on 10 Dec 2017. Output is to be assessed.
Social Safeguards Management Consultant (SSMC ) mobilized in Q1-2015.
About 50 officials of NHA have been trained by SSMC in better safeguard management including trouble shooting of project implementation issues
Social safeguards implementation is complied with the ADB's Safeguards Policy Statement.
LARP monitoring reports are being regularly received, reviewed, cleared and disclosed to ADB website.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/40075-033/main#project-tenders
